config.finishSingleSubtitleFirst: Finish one subtitle Job before starting the next
config.enableNameDetection: Enable AI name detection on upload
config.defaultLanguageDescription: Used as the default interface language for new users and users who have selected System default.
config.tipDefaultChunkSize: How many subtitle lines are grouped into one translation chunk by default.
config.tipMaxRetries: How many times the worker retries a failed chunk or judge step before marking it failed.
config.tipSessionTimeout: How long a user session remains valid before requiring login again.
config.tipFinishOneFirst: When enabled, all chunks for one target language are completed before moving to the next target language.
config.tipNameDetection: When enabled, BCookieSubs uses a name formatter model to guess movie/show details from filenames.
config.tipShowPosters: When enabled, posters are shown on dashboard media cards when available. Requires AI name detection to be active.
config.tipMovieDb: When enabled, BCookieSubs can fetch metadata and posters from TheMovieDB if an API key is configured. Requires AI name detection to be active.
config.tipGateBySchedule: When enabled, translation only runs during configured schedule windows.
config.tipLibraryScan: When enabled, BCookieSubs scans configured media folders for new subtitle and media files.
config.tipRootLibraryFolder: Can configure the root folder used to restrict library path browsing. When set, browsing and new library paths are confined to this folder.
config.tipAutoClearLogs: When enabled, old logs are automatically deleted according to the retention period below.
config.tipDeleteLogsOlderThan: Logs older than this number of days are deleted when auto-clear is active.
config.tipActiveTheme: Controls the active color theme used by the interface. Custom themes can be created below.
config.tipWhisperModel: Whisper model used to generate source subtitles. Default is large-v3-turbo.
config.tipWhisperTimestampsLength: Maximum dialogue length per subtitle timestamp pair. Must be between 1 and 500.
config.tipWhisperUseCuda: Run Whisper on an NVIDIA GPU. Only available when the deployment was set up with GPU support.
config.tipWhisperEnabled: Allow users to create source subtitles directly from media files using Whisper.
config.tipWhisperModelRootPath: Optional directory where Whisper models are downloaded and cached. In Docker this defaults to /data/whisper-models.

step2.title: How BCookieSubs Works
step2.subtitle: A quick overview before you configure the system.
step2.roleTranslationDesc: The core role. The model receives subtitle lines broken into chunks and returns translated text. At least one Translation model is required. When multiple Translation models are active they each produce a candidate translation, and the Judge picks the best one.
step2.roleJudgeDesc: BCookieSubs ships with 5 translation prompt variants by default. Each chunk is translated once per active prompt, producing multiple candidates. The Judge evaluates all candidates and selects the most accurate translation. Without a Judge model, the first candidate is used directly.
step2.roleNameFormatterDesc: Identifies the movie or TV show from a filename or folder name. Used when uploading subtitles and during library scanning so that translations are tagged with the correct media. Requires the TheMovieDB integration to be configured for best results.
step2.promptsDesc: Each role uses a prompt template that is sent to the model. Multiple prompt versions can exist. BCookieSubs tracks which version performs best for each model and language combination and promotes it automatically.
step2.placeholdersLabel: Placeholder tokens in prompt text are replaced at runtime:
step2.promptsEditHint: Prompts can be edited and extended on the Prompts page at any time.
step2.defaultChunkSizeDesc: Number of subtitle lines sent to the model per request. Smaller chunks give more context per call; larger chunks are faster overall.
step2.finishOneFirstDesc: When enabled, all chunks for one target language complete before the next language starts. Useful for watching progress in real time.
step2.nameDetectionDesc: Enables the Name Formatter to automatically identify media from filenames during upload and library scanning.
step2.tmdbIntegrationDesc: Connects to TheMovieDB API to fetch posters, genres, and release years for matched media. Requires an API key.
step2.showPostersDesc: Display media artwork in the subtitle list and library views. Requires TheMovieDB to be configured.
step2.libraryScanningDesc: Automatically scans configured library paths for new video and subtitle files on a schedule, creating translation jobs as needed.
step2.autoClearLogsDesc: Deletes log entries older than a configured number of days to keep the log table manageable.
step2.defaultTargetLangsDesc: The ordered list of languages that subtitles are translated into by default. Pre-selected for every user when they upload a subtitle file or trigger a library translation.
step2.perUserLangsDesc: Each user can replace the system defaults with their own language list via their Account settings. New users start with the system defaults. You will set the system defaults in the next step.
